intake.prompt: What role is being onboarded? (e.g., Senior Frontend Engineer, Product Manager, Sales Rep)
Key tools/systems they need access to (comma-separated, or press Enter to auto-detect from role):
Any special onboarding requirements? (or press Enter to skip)

generate.prompt:
Create a comprehensive 30-60-90 day onboarding checklist for a new {role} in {department}.

Tools/systems they need: {tools}
Special requirements: {special_notes}

Structure as:

## Pre-Start (before day 1)
- [ ] IT/access items
- [ ] Equipment needs

## Week 1: Orientation
- [ ] Daily items with specific goals

## Days 8-30: Foundation
- [ ] Key milestones, meetings to attend, docs to read

## Days 31-60: Contribution
- [ ] First deliverables, deeper team integration

## Days 61-90: Independence
- [ ] Ownership areas, first solo project

Be specific to the role — a {role} needs different onboarding than a generic employee. Include the actual tool names from the list provided.

humanReview.prompt:
Review the checklist below and enter any changes, additions, or press Enter to approve:

{checklist}
